plumbing.name: 2020 Minnesota Plumbing Code (Minn. Rules ch. 4714), 2018 UPC with MN amendments; replaces IRC P chapters

elsewhere: The Minnesota State Building Code applies statewide, but municipalities decide whether to enforce it; counties without enforcement have no residential permits. Energy code for residential is the Minnesota-specific chapter 1322, not the plain IECC; an updated residential energy code (2024) was in rulemaking and its status is unconfirmed.
